meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾工作：确认用户身份并授予所有者角色、迁移旧版记忆、检查容器配置、以及帮你移植自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration”等关键词，并且已经运行过 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 脚本后触发。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移。
检查迁移状态，然后设置所有者。
迁移旧版记忆并检查容器配置。
say.note: 执行记忆迁移和容器配置验证。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through finishing the NanoClaw v1 to v2 migration: confirm user identity and grant owner role, migrate legacy memory, check container configs, and help port custom code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", and after you have run `bash migrate-v2.sh`.

say_en.text: Help me finish the v1 to v2 migration.
Check migration status and set up the owner.
say_en.note: Claude reads handoff.json and guides you to confirm the owner.

say_en.text: Migrate legacy memory and check container configs.
say_en.note: Performs memory migration and container config verification.
